title: Maximum Subarray Sum
difficulty: Medium
position: 4
=== statement
Find the largest sum of a contiguous, non-empty part of the array.

Watch out: all numbers can be negative, and the sum can be larger than a 32-bit integer.
=== input
The first line has `n`. The second line has the `n` integers.
=== output
Print the largest sum.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 50000
-10^9 <= values <= 10^9
=== sample
9
-2 1 -3 4 -1 2 1 -5 4
--- expected
6
=== sample
3
-3 -1 -2
--- expected
-1
=== test
1
-7
--- expected
-7
=== test
5
-3 -1 -2 -5 -4
--- expected
-1
=== test
4
1 2 3 4
